summary: CEMEX SAB de CV filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of $1.5 billion 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036 in an underwritten public offering. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by Cemex Corp. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including repayment of indebtedness. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
